description: Controlled human trials of candidate anti-dengue drugs that failed, with the documented mechanistic reason. Used by the synthesis step to reason about likely translational failure modes for host-directed targets. No host-directed antiviral is approved for any Aedes-borne arbovirus.

trials.trial: Tricou et al., PLoS NTD 2010 (randomized, Vietnam)
trials.outcome: No reduction in viremia or duration of fever; more adverse events.
trials.failure_reason: No antiviral effect at clinically tolerated doses; pleiotropic host activity did not translate to virologic benefit.

trials.trial: Nguyen et al., Clin Infect Dis 2013 (randomized)
trials.outcome: No effect on viremia or fever kinetics.
trials.failure_reason: Prodrug inefficiently phosphorylated to the active triphosphate in dengue-infected cells; insufficient intracellular active metabolite.

trials.trial: Low et al., Lancet Infect Dis 2014 (CELADEN, randomized)
trials.outcome: No significant reduction in viral load or fever burden vs placebo.
trials.failure_reason: Insufficient target engagement at tolerated exposure and dosing after peak viremia; host glucosidase inhibition did not reach an antiviral threshold. (Directly relevant to glycosylation host factors.)

trials.trial: Whitehorn et al., Clin Infect Dis 2016 (randomized)
trials.outcome: Safe but no effect on clinical or virologic endpoints.
trials.failure_reason: Statin lipid/anti-inflammatory activity did not translate to antiviral benefit within the treatment window.

trials.trial: Tam et al., Clin Infect Dis 2012 (randomized)
trials.outcome: Safe; no benefit on viremia or clinical outcomes.
trials.failure_reason: Immunosuppression did not alter viremia or disease course; wrong node in pathogenesis.

trials.trial: Suputtamongkol et al., Clin Infect Dis 2021 (randomized)
trials.outcome: Faster viral clearance signal but no clinical benefit.
trials.failure_reason: In-vitro antiviral concentrations not achievable in vivo at safe doses; virologic signal did not yield clinical benefit.
